sources.title: Tensor complexes: Multilinear free resolutions constructed from higher tensors

sources.inspection: Publisher PDF: section 2.3, Definition 5.1, Theorem 5.3, and Proposition 8.1; fixed arXiv v5 metadata. Parent and theory agent inspected these independently in the same session.
sources.used_scope: Pinching-weight complex terms and the Segre-incidence support; specialized over C at a zero-free tensor of format (a,N,M).
